name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
description: Authentic poached chicken served over fragrant rice cooked in chicken fat, garlic, ginger, and pandan leaves, accompanied by red chili garlic dip and ginger scallion oil.
ingredients: 1/4 cup Rendered chicken fat or vegetable oil
Garlic chili sauce, ginger scallion oil & dark soy sauce
instructions: Poach whole chicken with smashed ginger and scallions in boiling water for 35 minutes; plunge into ice water to set gelatinous skin.
Sauté minced garlic, ginger, and chicken fat in a pan; add rinsed Jasmine rice and toast lightly.
Transfer rice to cooker, cook using chicken poaching broth and knotted pandan leaves.
Slice poached chicken, rub skin with sesame oil, and serve over rice with chili garlic sauce and ginger oil.

name: Singapore Chilli Crab
description: Sweet, savory, and mildly spicy mud crab stir-fried in a rich tomato-chili egg gravy, served with golden fried mantou buns.
ingredients: 2 lbs Fresh Mud crab or Dungeness crab (cleaned & quartered)
4 tbsp Chili paste (shallots, garlic, red chilies, ginger)
1/2 cup Tomato ketchup & 3 tbsp Sweet chili sauce
instructions: Sauté blended chili paste, garlic, and ginger in a hot wok until fragrant.
Add tomato ketchup, chili sauce, soybean paste, and water to build gravy.
Add crab pieces, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Whisk in beaten eggs off heat to create silky egg ribbons in the gravy.
Serve hot with golden fried mantou buns for dipping.

name: Authentic Nasi Lemak
description: Fragrant coconut rice steamed with pandan leaves, served with slow-cooked anchovy sambal, fried peanuts, hard-boiled egg, and fried chicken.
ingredients: 2 cups Jasmine rice cooked in 1/2 cup coconut milk & pandan
1/2 cup Sambal paste (chili, shallots, tamarind, belacan)
1/2 cup Crispy fried anchovies (Ikan Bilis) & roasted peanuts
instructions: Cook rice with coconut milk, water, salt, lemongrass, and pandan leaves in a rice cooker.
Fry anchovies and peanuts in oil until golden brown and crispy.
Slow-cook blended sambal paste with tamarind juice and sugar until oil separates.
Assemble coconut rice mound on banana leaf with sambal, anchovies, peanuts, cucumber, boiled egg, and fried chicken.

name: Singapore Katong Laksa
description: Rich, spicy coconut broth infused with dried shrimp and laksa herbs, poured over cut rice vermicelli, plump prawns, and fish cakes.
ingredients: 8 oz Thick rice vermicelli noodles (cut into short strands)
1 cup Coconut milk & 2 cups Prawn broth
3 tbsp Laksa spice paste (dried shrimp, galangal, lemongrass, chilies)
instructions: Stir-fry laksa paste in oil until aromatic; add prawn stock, coconut milk, and tofu puffs.
Simmer broth gently and poach prawns and sliced fish cakes directly in the soup.
Place short rice noodles into bowls, ladle boiling coconut broth over top.
Garnish with chopped laksa leaves and serve with a spoon.

name: Assorted Dim Sum Basket
description: Traditional bamboo basket filled with steamed pork and shrimp Shumai, translucent Har Gow dumplings, and fluffy Char Siu buns.
ingredients: 2 Fluffy Char Siu BBQ Pork Buns
Chili oil & black vinegar with ginger
instructions: Line bamboo steamer tiers with parchment paper.
Arrange dumplings and buns evenly inside steamer.
Steam over boiling water for 8-10 minutes until piping hot.
Serve directly in bamboo basket alongside chili oil and black vinegar.

name: Cantonese Char Siu
description: Savory-sweet Cantonese roasted pork collar glazed with hoisin, honey, five-spice, and red fermented bean curd.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs Pork collar or shoulder (cut into long strips)
2 tbsp Hoisin sauce & 1 tbsp Oyster sauce
instructions: Marinate pork strips in hoisin, oyster sauce, five-spice, and Shaoxing wine for 4 hours.
Roast at 400°F (200°C) for 25 minutes, turning once.
Baste heavily with honey glaze and broil for 3 minutes until charred at edges.
Slice and serve over steamed white rice.

name: Crispy Siu Yuk (Roast Pork Belly)
description: Crispy Cantonese roasted pork belly with crunchy, blistered crackling skin and tender, seasoned meat.
ingredients: 2 lbs Pork belly block with skin intact
1 cup Coarse sea salt (for top crust)
instructions: Prick skin thoroughly with sharp needles; dry skin in refrigerator overnight.
Season meat side with five-spice and Shaoxing wine.
Cover skin with salt crust and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 45 minutes.
Remove salt crust and blast at 450°F (230°C) for 15 minutes until skin crackles into crispy blisters.

name: Chee Cheong Fun
description: Steamed rolled rice noodle sheets served with sweet dark sauce, chili paste, toasted sesame seeds, and fried shallots.
instructions: Steam rice noodle rolls for 5 minutes until soft.
Slice into bite-sized cylinders and arrange on a plate.
Drizzle with sweet dark soy, chili paste, and sesame oil.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and fried shallots.

name: Classic Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with sweet-savory tamarind sauce, tender chicken, scrambled egg, bean sprouts, and roasted peanuts.
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes until pliable, then drain.
Whisk tamarind paste, fish sauce, and brown sugar together in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat, cook chicken until golden.
Push chicken to the side, crack in eggs and scramble gently.
Add noodles and sauce mixture; toss rapidly for 2-3 minutes until sauce is absorbed.
Stir in bean sprouts, serve immediately topped with crushed peanuts and lime.

name: Pad See Ew
description: Wide flat rice noodles stir-fried in sweet dark soy sauce with tender beef, egg, and Chinese broccoli.
ingredients: 1 tbsp Soy sauce & 1 tbsp Oyster sauce
instructions: Sear beef in a scorching hot wok with oil for 2 minutes; set aside.
Sauté minced garlic and Chinese broccoli stems until crisp-tender.
Push veggies aside, scramble eggs, then toss in wide rice noodles.
Pour dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, and oyster sauce over noodles.
Stir-fry on high heat to sear noodles with a subtle char, then toss in beef and broccoli leaves.

name: Spicy Thai Basil Pork (Pad Krapow)
description: Classic Thai street food featuring minced pork stir-fried with Thai holy basil, garlic, chilies, and a fried egg over Jasmine rice.
ingredients: 1 cup Fresh Thai holy basil leaves
1 tbsp Soy sauce & 1 tbsp Oyster sauce
instructions: Pound garlic and chilies together into a coarse paste.
Stir-fry garlic chili paste in hot oil until fragrant (approx. 30 seconds).
Add ground pork, stir-frying until browned and cooked through.
Stir in soy sauce and oyster sauce, then remove from heat and toss in basil until wilted.
Fry an egg until edges are crisp and serve over pork and jasmine rice.

name: Authentic Pork Tonkotsu Ramen
description: Rich, creamy pork bone broth served over springy ramen noodles, topped with tender chashu pork belly, soft-boiled ajitama egg, and wood ear mushrooms.
instructions: Heat pork bone broth and whisk in shoyu tare base until simmering.
Boil fresh ramen noodles for 1.5 minutes until al dente, then drain well.
Sear chashu pork slices with a blowtorch or hot skillet until fragrant.
Divide noodles and hot broth between bowls.
Top with chashu pork, halved ajitama eggs, mushrooms, scallions, and nori.

name: Spicy Seafood Kimchi Ramen
description: Fiery Korean soup packed with ramen noodles, mixed seafood, aged kimchi, soft-boiled egg, and scallions.
instructions: Bring broth to a simmer with chopped kimchi and gochujang paste.
Add ramen noodles and seafood mix to the boiling broth.
Cook for 3-4 minutes until noodles are chewy and seafood is cooked through.
Transfer to a bowl, top with a soft-boiled egg half and sliced green onions.

name: Teriyaki Tofu Rice Bowl
description: Crispy pan-fried tofu glazed in homemade teriyaki sauce, served over fluffy jasmine rice with steamed broccoli.
instructions: Toss cubed tofu in cornstarch until lightly coated.
Pan-fry tofu in vegetable oil over medium-high heat until golden crisp on all sides (approx. 8-10 mins).
Whisk soy sauce, honey, mirin, and 1 tbsp water together.
Pour teriyaki sauce over the crispy tofu; simmer for 2 minutes until glossy and thick.
Serve tofu over warm jasmine rice with broccoli, garnished with sesame seeds.

name: Pork Tonkatsu Curry
description: Crispy panko-breaded pork cutlet served alongside rich, savory Japanese curry sauce and warm steamed rice.
instructions: Boil cubed potatoes and carrots until tender; dissolve curry roux blocks in 2 cups hot water and combine with veggies.
Dredge pork chops in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat thoroughly with panko breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry cutlets in oil at 350°F (175°C) for 5-6 minutes until golden and crispy.
Slice cutlet into strips and arrange over rice, ladling warm curry sauce alongside.

name: Classic Cheeseburger
description: Juicy seared beef patty topped with melted cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and special sauce on a toasted brioche bun.
instructions: Divide ground beef into two loose balls, then smash flat into thin patties.
Season aggressively with salt and black pepper.
Sear in a hot cast-iron skillet for 2.5 minutes until a deep crust forms.
Flip patties, immediately top with cheddar, and cook for 1 more minute.
Toast brioche buns, spread burger sauce, and assemble with lettuce, tomato, and pickles.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Classic Roman pasta with crispy guanciale or pancetta, tossed with egg yolks, grated Pecorino Romano, and cracked black pepper.
instructions: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Crisp pancetta in a skillet over medium heat until golden; remove from heat.
Whisk eggs and Pecorino Romano together in a bowl with plenty of black pepper.
Toss hot pasta into the skillet with pancetta, then quickly stir in the egg mixture off heat.
Add pasta water as needed to create a glossy, creamy emulsion.

name: Ribeye Steak with Herb Butter
description: Juicy, well-marbled ribeye steak pan-seared in cast-iron and basted with garlic, rosemary, and compound herb butter.
ingredients: Coarse Kosher salt & cracked black pepper
instructions: Pat steak dry and season generously with kosher salt and black pepper.
Sear in a red-hot cast-iron skillet for 3 minutes until a deep crust forms.
Flip steak and add butter, smashed garlic, rosemary, and thyme to skillet.
Spoon melted herb butter continuously over steak while cooking to desired doneness.
Rest steak on a cutting board for 5-7 minutes before slicing.

name: Beef Bolognese Pappardelle
description: Slow-simmered rich beef ragù with tomatoes, aromatics, and red wine over broad ribbons of pappardelle pasta.
ingredients: 1 Medium onion, carrot, & celery stalk (finely diced)
instructions: Sauté diced onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil until soft.
Add ground beef, browning thoroughly while breaking up chunks.
Pour in red wine to deglaze, simmering until liquid reduces by half.
Crush tomatoes into the pot, lower heat, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Toss with cooked pappardelle and top with freshly grated Parmesan.

name: Creamy Tuscan Salmon
description: Pan-seared salmon fillets simmered in a velvety garlic, sun-dried tomato, and spinach cream sauce over penne.
instructions: Boil penne pasta in salted water according to package directions.
Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper; sear in a skillet for 4 mins per side until cooked through, then remove.
In the same skillet, sauté garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Reduce heat, pour in heavy cream, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in spinach and parmesan until spinach wilts and sauce thickens.
Toss in cooked pasta and place salmon fillets back on top.

name: Hearty Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Comforting classic soup brimming with shredded chicken, egg noodles, carrots, celery, and fresh herbs in a rich broth.
instructions: Melt butter in a large soup pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery; cook for 6 minutes until softened.
Pour in chicken stock and bring to a boil.
Add egg noodles and simmer uncovered for 8-10 minutes until tender.
Stir in shredded chicken and fresh parsley; heat through for 2 minutes.
Season to taste with salt and pepper, serve warm.

name: Greek Lemon Orzo Soup (Avgolemono)
description: Silky, velvety Greek soup combining tender shredded chicken, orzo pasta, and a bright lemon-egg broth.
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a pot. Add orzo and cook for 9 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk eggs and fresh lemon juice together thoroughly.
Slowly ladle 1 cup of hot broth into the egg mixture while whisking constantly to temper the eggs.
Reduce pot heat to low, slowly pour tempered egg mixture back into the pot while stirring continuously.
Add shredded chicken and simmer gently for 3 minutes until thick and creamy (do not boil).
Garnish with fresh dill.

name: Vegetarian Falafel Pita Wrap
description: Crispy chickpea falafel balls tucked in warm pita pockets with diced cucumber, tomatoes, and creamy tahini sauce.
instructions: Warm pita bread and cut open top to create pockets.
Stuff pita pockets with fresh lettuce, cucumber, tomato, and falafel balls.
Drizzle generously with creamy tahini sauce and top with pickled red onions.

name: Seafood Paella
description: Authentic Spanish saffron rice cooked with shrimp, mussels, calamari, peas, and bell peppers in a wide pan.
ingredients: 1 pinch Saffron threads dissolved in 3.5 cups fish stock
instructions: Sauté bell pepper, garlic, and diced tomato in a wide paella pan with olive oil.
Add rice and stir to coat in oil for 2 minutes.
Pour in saffron fish stock; cook uncovered without stirring for 15 minutes.
Nestle mixed seafood and peas into the rice; cook 8 minutes longer until liquid absorbs and socarrat crust forms.

name: Beef Tacos al Pastor
description: Flavorful seasoned flank steak served in warm corn tortillas with diced pineapple, chopped onions, and fresh cilantro.
instructions: Season sliced steak generously with taco seasoning.
Sear steak in a scorching hot skillet for 3-4 minutes until nicely browned.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet until soft and pliable.
Assemble tacos with beef, a spoon of diced pineapple, raw onion, and cilantro.
Serve hot with salsa verde on the side.

name: Pork Carnitas Burrito Bowl
description: Crispy slow-cooked shredded pork served over cilantro-lime rice, black beans, corn salsa, and fresh avocado.
instructions: Crisp up cooked pork carnitas in a hot skillet for 5 minutes.
Base each bowl with cilantro-lime rice.
Top with equal portions of carnitas, black beans, corn, and avocado slices.
Finish with a dollop of sour cream and sprinkled Cotija cheese.

name: Loaded Nacho Platter
description: Crispy tortilla chips piled high with melted cheese, black beans, jalapenos, guacamole, and sour cream.
ingredients: 2 cups Shredded Cheddar & Monterey Jack cheese
instructions: Arrange tortilla chips on a baking sheet in an even layer.
Top with black beans, jalapenos, and a heavy layer of shredded cheese.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 8-10 minutes until cheese is completely melted and bubbly.
Top with scoops of guacamole, sour cream, and fresh diced tomatoes before serving.

name: Classic Fudge Chocolate Cake
description: Moist double-chocolate layer cake covered in silky dark chocolate ganache frosting.
ingredients: 2 cups All-purpose flour & 3/4 cup Cocoa powder
8 oz Dark chocolate melted with heavy cream
instructions: Whisk dry ingredients, add buttermilk and eggs, then stir in hot coffee.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 30 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely, then coat in glossy chocolate ganache frosting.

name: Japanese Fluffy Soufflé Cheesecake
description: Cotton-soft, jiggly Japanese soufflé cheesecake dusted with powdered sugar.
instructions: Melt cream cheese, butter, and milk together; whisk in egg yolks and flour.
Whip egg whites with sugar into soft meringue peaks; fold into batter.
Bake in a water bath at 320°F (160°C) for 60 minutes.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve.

name: Brown Sugar Boba Milk Tea
description: Chewy tapioca pearls simmered in dark brown sugar syrup, layered with ice and fresh whole milk.
ingredients: 1 cup Fresh whole milk or Oat milk
instructions: Boil boba pearls for 5 minutes until chewy; drain.
Simmer pearls with brown sugar and 2 tbsp water until syrupy.
Spoon boba syrup into glasses, add ice cubes, and pour fresh milk and black tea.

name: Vanilla Bean Ice Cream Sundae
description: Rich vanilla bean ice cream drenched in hot fudge, topped with whipped cream, toasted almonds, and a cherry.
instructions: Scoop vanilla ice cream into a chilled bowl.
Drizzle warm fudge sauce over top.
Add whipped cream, toasted almonds, and finish with a cherry.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Sweet Thai sticky rice infused with coconut milk, served alongside ripe sliced yellow mango and toasted sesame seeds.
ingredients: 3 tbsp Palm sugar or white sugar
instructions: Steam soaked glutinous rice for 20 minutes until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt over low heat until dissolved.
Pour sweet coconut milk sauce over hot cooked sticky rice; cover and let absorb for 10 minutes.
Plate sticky rice with sliced ripe mango, drizzle remaining sauce, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Churros with Chocolate
description: Crispy golden fried Spanish dough dusted in cinnamon sugar, served with thick dark dipping chocolate.
ingredients: 1 cup Water + 2 tbsp Sugar + 2 tbsp Butter
instructions: Bring water, sugar, and butter to a boil; stir in flour until dough ball forms.
Transfer dough to a piping bag fitted with a star tip.
Pipe 4-inch strips directly into hot oil (350°F) and fry for 3-4 minutes until golden.
Drain churros and roll immediately in cinnamon sugar.
Melt dark chocolate with heavy cream to make thick dipping sauce.
